issue_context.title: Enable SMJ in joining tables in descending order.
issue_context.body:
## Feature Request

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:**

Currently the SMJ executor doesn't support join tables in descending order, and we can't choose it whenever it is the case. However it should be supported and it won't be too difficult.

**Describe the feature you'd like:**

Enable SMJ in descending order.

Take a look at how index lookup merge join supported joining in descending order.

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/cd9c65aad2567a89a677edf2c17876f57b3044f2/executor/index_lookup_merge_join.go#L517-L561

Also see a previous bug https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/14483 and related fix https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/14505.
